content.short: SX Bet is a peer to peer blockchain betting exchange for sports, where users trade odds against each other, not against a house.
content.description: SX Bet, formerly SportX, is a blockchain betting exchange built on SX Network, a chain designed specifically for prediction markets. Rather than taking positions against a sportsbook, users post and match odds against other bettors, so pricing is set by the order book and margins stay tighter than a traditional operator's. Coverage spans the major North American leagues alongside global sports, and the platform has added peer to peer parlays, letting users combine legs while still trading against other participants.
